summary: Barclays PLC and Barclays Bank PLC furnished a joint Form 6-K disclosing that Non-Executive Director Mary Mack joined the Board Nominations Committees of both entities as an additional member effective 23 September 2026, per the 24 September 2026 announcement to the London Stock Exchange. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or closing condition is stated, and the filing is a routine governance/committee-membership update rather than a special situation. No deal mechanics, regulatory clock, or overhang arise; no risk-arb angle exists beyond ordinary board-composition monitoring.
